name: trackiq-amazon-dsp-performance
title: TrackIQ: Amazon DSP Audience and Creative Performance
summary: Breaks Amazon DSP down by audience, creative, inventory source, technology and geography to show which segments actually recruit customers and which burn impressions. Ranks on new-to-brand purchases, detail page views and cost per action rather than ROAS, because DSP revenue is not returned at these dimensions.
